signin.title: Sign in to Multica
signin.description: Enter your email to get a sign-in code

verify.title: Check your email
verify.description: We sent a verification code to {{email}}

cli.title: Authorize CLI
cli.description: Allow the CLI to access Multica as {{email}}

activate.title: Activate a device
activate.description: Enter the code shown by the CLI on the device you want to sign in
activate.approved_description: You can return to the terminal — the CLI will finish signing in on its own.
activate.confirm_description: Approve only if you started this sign-in yourself.

errors.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code. Check the code in the terminal, or run `multica login --device` again.
errors.approve_failed: Could not approve the device. Try again.

errors.server_unreachable: Make sure the server is running.
errors.cli_auth_failed: Failed to authorize CLI. Please sign in again.
errors.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

cli_callback.invalid_description: The CLI callback address is invalid. Return to the terminal and restart login with --callback-host 127.0.0.1 if the browser runs on the CLI machine, or use the CLI machine's RFC 1918 LAN IPv4 address.

desktop_handoff.opening_description: Didn't open automatically? Click Open Multica Desktop.

callback.login_failed: We couldn't complete your sign-in. Please try again.
callback.signup_prohibited: User registration is disabled on this self-hosted instance.
callback.email_not_allowed: This email address or domain is not allowed on this instance.
callback.google_account_no_email: Google did not provide an email address for this sign-in.
callback.oauth_code_invalid: The Google authorization code is invalid, expired, or has already been used. Sign in again.

recovery.title: Reconnecting to Multica
recovery.description: Your session is still saved. We'll retry automatically when the connection recovers.
